\section{The product-coverage matrix}
\label{sup:coverage}

Table~\ref{tab:coverage} answers, per module: what native geometry the
release holds, the dominant spatial-evidence class the cube allocates on,
which spatial products the sector publishes itself, and the dominant
temporal class of its monthly resolution. It is generated from
\texttt{outputs/pakemis\_product\_coverage.csv}, itself derived from the
source-stream ledger, so a sector whose coverage changes cannot leave this
table behind. The ADM2 monthly view now ships sector-resolved as
\texttt{outputs/pakemis\_adm2\_monthly\_sector.csv} (module $\times$
shape $\times$ gas $\times$ month, a tested partition of the aggregate
view); nesting agriculture's raster inside its district table remains a
declared deferral, carried here rather than implied to exist.

\begin{table}[htbp]
\centering
\scriptsize
\begin{tabular}{@{}lllll@{}}
\toprule
\textbf{Module} & \textbf{Geometry held} & \textbf{Spatial class} & \textbf{Own products} & \textbf{Monthly} \\
\midrule
Agriculture & diffuse & S3 & district$+$grid & TE4 \\
Electricity generation & facilities & S1 & provincial & TE2 \\
Road transport & diffuse & S3 & provincial & TE2 \\
Residential fuel & diffuse & S3 & provincial$+$district$+$grid & TE3 \\
Industrial combustion & diffuse, facilities, points & S2 & provincial & TE3 \\
Cement (IPPU) & diffuse, facilities & S2 & provincial & TE2 \\
Waste & diffuse, points & S2 & provincial$+$district & TE4 \\
Fugitive oil and gas & diffuse, facilities, points & S3 & provincial & TE4 \\
Railways & network, points & S2 & provincial$+$district$+$grid & TE2 \\
Domestic aviation & none (S4), facilities & NA & provincial & TE2 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\caption{Product coverage by module. Geometry held lists the geometry-id

raster plus unallocated); spatial and
monthly columns give the emissions-dominant class.}
\label{tab:coverage}
